text: {"summary":"Ratan Tata said he feels lonely and pained by press attacks and attempts to damage his and the Tata Group's reputation amid his feud with Cyrus Mistry, but he was deeply moved by shareholders' support at the Tata Chemicals meeting. He said he believes the truth will prevail."}

{"summary":"The author gave up the Galaxy S7, which he calls the best phone he's used, for an iPhone 6s Plus because of battery life. As a heavy user, his S7 died around 5 p.m., while the iPhone, despite a smaller battery, lasts much longer thanks to better hardware-software optimization."}

{"summary":"The article lists 12 well-regarded 2016 films to stream: 11 on Netflix, including The Jungle Book, The Invitation, 13th, Barry, Zootopia, Under the Shadow, The Little Prince and Captain America: Civil War, plus Whiskey Tango Foxtrot with Tina Fey, which is the one on Hulu."}

{"summary":"About 40 people were burned at a Tony Robbins firewalking event in Dallas, which the post calls dumb because the likely cause was people lingering on the hot coals to take selfies and videos. Firewalking is safe when done correctly, since coals have low thermal conductivity and contact time is short."}

{"summary":"Scientists worry that Finding Dory will spark a surge in demand for blue tang fish as pets, as Finding Nemo did for clownfish (a 40% sales rise). Unlike clownfish, blue tangs don't breed in captivity or fare well in tanks, and lax collection rules in Indonesia and the Philippines could lead to overharvesting and ecosystem damage."}

{"summary":"The post teases that designer Charlotte Ronson has a surprisingly down-to-earth, livable New York home rather than a stuffy, antique-filled showcase. The article shows her airy white-walled apartment with eclectic art, baby blue dining chairs, bright furniture accents, and fresh flowers she keeps around at all times."}

{"summary":"The post teases a list of 29 standout 2016 pieces by women, which HuffPost compiled for the fifth year running. It spans essays, satire, and reporting on Hillary Clinton, Trump, sexual assault, race, and abortion, with authors like Roxane Gay, Solange Knowles, Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, Rebecca Traister and Masha Gessen."}

{"summary":"The canceled show is CBS's \"We Are Men,\" pulled after weak ratings (6.4 million viewers in its premiere, 5.4 million in its second episode). \"2 Broke Girls\" moves to 8:30 p.m. from Oct. 14, and \"Mike and Molly\" returns Nov. 4 in the 9 p.m. slot, with \"The Big Bang Theory\" repeats airing there until then."}

{"summary":"The post teases a BuzzFeed list of 19 teens whose quirky 2016 moments went viral. They include a Mulan-themed school ID, a teen who asked himself to homecoming, a boy who befriended a deer named Money, a girl stuck in a Barney head for 45 minutes, and a Pokemon Go player who found a dead body."}

{"summary":"ScHoolboy Q said he almost quit rap after 'Oxymoron' because constant touring and work kept him away from his 7-year-old daughter, and he didn't want to put his career and money over his family. He's back with his new album, but fans expect he may step away eventually."}

{"summary":"Cinematographer Dean Cundey revealed on a new Blu-ray commentary that he and John Carpenter lit the actors so a small \"eye light\" gleam shows in human characters' eyes, giving them life, so a character lacking that glint may be the Thing. Viewers can use this to judge whether the film's final two survivors are human."}

{"summary":"The food industry has announced plans to replace confusing food label wording with simpler, easier-to-understand language, which will soon appear on products in grocery stores. That is why confusing labels may soon disappear, though the article gives no further detail on the specific changes."}

{"summary":"Telco Spark is New Zealand's most complained about company, with 140 complaints to the Commerce Commission in its 2016 Consumer Issues Paper, ahead of Vodafone (133) and Trade Me sellers (121). Price was the top issue, and Spark said none of the complaints were taken forward."}

{"summary":"Amy Cazin, CEO of organic deodorant maker Primal Pit Paste (P3 Organics), turned down Wal-Mart's offer to carry her products because her young company wasn't ready to scale to such volumes. She kept growing organically from a $100 start, and her products are now sold at Whole Foods."}

{"summary":"The creepy turn is that men are using period-tracking apps like iAmAMan and uPMS to monitor female colleagues' and partners' cycles, supposedly to avoid them when they have PMS. One woman said coworkers began tracking her after an argument, and the public reacted with dismay on Twitter."}

{"summary":"McLaren plans to spend £1 billion ($1.45 billion) over six years on R&D to launch 15 new cars by 2022, including a P1 successor and an electric model, aiming to grow annual sales from 2,000 to 5,000. Most money goes to new hybrid powertrains and carbon fiber structures."}

{"summary":"While riding through Little Rock, Arkansas, bikers Bret and Zach Winingar found a starving, emaciated dog locked inside a chewed-up crate. They rescued her, named her Charlie Bravo (CB), nursed her to health and adopted her, and donations from her viral story now fund a charity called C.B's Angels."}

{"summary": "Robots and smart home gadgets like the Roomba and Nest haven't revolutionized homes because they demand too much user effort while adding little value over existing appliances, and they struggle in messy, unpredictable real homes (e.g., a Roomba spreading dog poop), unlike controlled machines such as dishwashers."}

{"summary":"Amateur archaeologists from Underground Rome found a new network of tunnels beneath Emperor Hadrian's villa in Tivoli, Italy, including a passage linking the Academy area to a 2.5-mile underground road. The tunnels, carved by slaves, let thousands of slaves and merchants keep the estate running unseen, like crew corridors on a cruise ship."}

{"summary":"The unusual morning drink is bone broth, a slow-simmered soup of beef or chicken bones, veggies and apple cider vinegar that experts say is rich in calcium, magnesium and collagen and may help digestion, skin and immunity. It acts like a filling smoothie at breakfast, and the article includes a recipe."}

{"summary": "The post teases a big GTA 6 announcement, but the article is satire, not real news: it lists mock \"leaks\" like forced main characters, fixed vehicle physics, expensive microtransactions and no release date. Rockstar announced nothing real; the piece is a joke about GTA tropes."}

{"summary":"Whole Foods co-CEO Walter Robb says he won't hire people who show a lack of humility and an over sense of self-promotion. Google also prizes humility, and experts advise crediting coworkers and stressing your value to others, though Oracle's Larry Ellison favored confident candidates."}

{"summary":"The article teases that 'The Biggest Loser,' NBC's 12-year hit, isn't the lasting life-changer it appears to be. Contestants lost weight fast through eight-hour daily workouts, but that loss seems to have been only a temporary fix. The excerpt gives no further specifics, so the post's \"disturbing truth\" is that the results don't last."}

{"summary":"Indian ceiling fans have 3 blades because they're the main cooling source: lighter and faster, they create a convective cooling effect and save energy. US fans have 4 blades because they only supplement air conditioning, turning slower while moving a large mass of air to circulate it."}

{"summary":"Jessica Simpson wore an all-black outfit of skinny jeans, a low-cut top, blazer and patent stilettos to a Mexican dinner in Calabasas on Sept. 24 with fiance Eric Johnson and daughter Maxwell, three months after giving birth to son Ace. She says she's done having kids and tweeted she needs to make music."}

{"summary":"The article lists 20 smartphone apps that encourage outdoor activity, covering trail maps (Forest XPlorer, ViewRanger), stargazing (Star Walk 2), wildlife, geocaching, fishing, cycling, camping, parkour and kids' activities (Gruffalo Spotter, Hoop). The post is teasing this list of 20 apps, which includes both free and paid options."}

{"summary":"The thing Harvard researchers say everyone needs is close, intimate relationships: the 75-year Grant Study found that men with strong, stable connections to family and friends were happier, healthier and lived longer than isolated ones, while wealth, fame and career success didn't deliver the same benefit."}

{"summary":"The real secret is that Leann is expecting twins, not one baby. When her Grandpa Ried looks closer at the ultrasound and realizes there are two, he sobs and swears with joy; she later had twin girls in February 2016."}

{"summary":"The article lists Tesla facts: Musk wants the lineup to spell S3XY (Ford's trademark blocked the \"Model E\" name), and a semitruck and bus are planned. Hidden Easter eggs include a Rainbow Road, a James Bond submarine car and a Mars screen, and the Model S broke a crash-test machine and topped 300 miles of range."}

{"summary":"The Battlefield 1 open beta will end on Thursday, September 8, as announced by EA. A patch also removes time limits in Sinai Desert Conquest so matches run to 250 points, and server stress tests may cause downtime ahead of the October 21 launch."}

{"summary":"Saudi Arabia was the top buyer of U.S. weapons in 2011-2015, followed by the UAE, Turkey, South Korea, Australia, Taiwan, India, Singapore, Iraq and Egypt, per SIPRI. The Middle East takes about 40% of U.S. arms exports, and the U.S. supplies nearly a third of global arms exports."}

{"summary":"Nine-year-old Molly Sings sang Kasey Chambers' song with the lyrics \"Am I not pretty enough?\" in her blind audition on The Voice Kids Australia, moving the judges to tears. The judges' response was to turn their chairs, praise her confidence, and have Mel B pitch herself as coach with a girl-power appeal."}

{"summary":"Bill Maher's message to TV hosts interviewing President-elect Trump is to treat him as a politician, hold his feet to the fire, and not let him use them, a jab at Jimmy Fallon's hair-tousling interview. Maher said he'd still welcome Trump on his show, though he's unsure what Trump will do."}

{"summary":"Though Warren insists she's not running for president, her memoir A Fighting Chance shows a pattern of initially refusing roles (bankruptcy commission, consumer bureau, Senate) before being persuaded she could help people, and its fierce \"fighting chance\" rhetoric reads like a case for a White House bid."}

{"summary": "BBC commentator Peter Alliss was caught on a hot mic at the Masters saying Sergio Garcia's fiancée Angela Akins wore \"the shortest skirt in the country\" and joking \"there will be some fun in the hotel tonight.\" The BBC called the remark inappropriate, and the article recounts Alliss's history of sexist and controversial comments."}

{"summary":"The city is Sydney: LendLease sold all 391 apartments in the final stage of its Darling Square development within four hours on Saturday, with prices from A$630,000 to A$3.5 million. The sellout shows inner-city demand remains strong despite a looming glut of new apartments and renewed investor confidence."}

{"summary":"The post is teasing that Lindsay Lohan is collaborating with the band Duran Duran. She shared an Instagram photo of herself in the studio with the band's Simon le Bon and Nick Rhodes and her younger sister Ali Lohan, captioned \"recording with some greats!!!\""}

{"summary":"The tiny plastic tripod in pizza boxes is called a pizza saver; it props up the sagging cardboard lid so it doesn't touch the pizza and rip off the cheese. Invented by Long Island woman Carmela Vitale (patented 1985), she let the patent lapse in 1993 and never profited from it."}

{"summary":"The 9-5 workday will fade by about 2030 for four reasons: millennials want flexible schedules (77% say it boosts productivity) and work-family balance, they value continuing education that eats into work hours, companies are dropping costly offices for remote work, and telecommuting raised productivity 13% in one Chinese study."}

{"summary":"Yes, according to research by Yonat Zwebner and colleagues at Hebrew University, IDC Herzliya and HEC Paris: people shown a headshot and four or five candidate names picked the correct name significantly more often than chance, suggesting people come to look like their names."}

{"summary":"The trend diet is intermittent fasting: Bob Harper suggests former Biggest Loser contestants, whose slowed metabolisms make regaining weight likely, could skip breakfast (about 400 calories) within a 10-hour eating window as he does. Early research is promising, but experts say there's no evidence yet that it works long term."}

{"summary":"The 2014-15 Knicks (5-36, on a 16-game losing streak) rank as the second-worst season in New York sports history, according to this list of the 10 worst. Only Columbia's 44-game football losing streak from 1983-88 ranks worse, while the 1962 Mets, 1966 Giants and 2009-10 Nets also make the list."}

{"summary":"Drake's \"Views\" has topped the Billboard 200 for nine straight weeks, the first album to manage such a streak with streaming making up most of its sales (about 77% last week) since Billboard added streaming in 2014. He's also the first male artist with nine consecutive weeks at No. 1 in over a decade."}

{"summary":"Former fast food workers say to avoid certain items, with #8 being KFC's BBQ sandwich, which one ex-employee claims is made from chicken too old to donate, soaked in BBQ sauce and held in a warmer for a month. Other warnings cover McDonald's dirty McCafe machines, Wendy's chili made from leftover meat, and moldy gas station Slurpee machines."}

{"summary":"The unnamed \"Glee\" star is Alex Newell, who plays transgender character Wade \"Unique\" Adams on the show and has joined the cast of \"Geography Club,\" an adaptation of Brent Hartinger's novel, alongside Scott Bakula, Nikki Blonsky and Ana Gasteyer. Newell says the script appealed to him because it could open people's eyes."}

{"summary":"On Galbani string cheese packaging, the three full-fat varieties each feature a different boy cartoon cheese character, while the only girl character appears on the low-fat version. A reader tipped off Jezebel after her 5-year-old noticed it, so the post is teasing that girls are linked to low-fat cheese and boys to full-fat."}

{"summary":"The mystery person in the post is film director Alfred Hitchcock, shown in a 1964 photo (via Retronaut) wearing a Beatles-style mop-top wig, which makes him look strikingly like Moe Howard of the Three Stooges. The reason for the wig is unknown."}

{"summary":"The post teases the identity of South India's last rat catcher: Eranna, a roughly 60-year-old non-Irula man living on a remote hill near Denkanikottai, Tamil Nadu. He catches and eats field rats, learned from his father, won't teach his children, and doesn't work for money."}

{"summary":"The author argues that the so-called \"pyramid schemes\" flooding social media, mostly run by mothers, are actually legal multi-level marketing businesses that work. She says they give struggling families a way to earn income from home, and urges readers to support these small business owners instead of chain stores."}

{"summary":"Bill Carter, who has covered TV for The New York Times for over 25 years and wrote The Late Shift, is taking the paper's voluntary buyout, calling it a wrenching decision driven by the generous severance. He has a contract for another late-night book and is seeking a new job."}

{"summary":"Google's secret car company is called Google Auto LLC, a subsidiary registered in 2011 to legally operate its self-driving car project, and listed as manufacturer of its 23 Lexus SUVs, likely to shield Google's assets if trouble arises. Google still says it will seek established automakers as manufacturing partners."}

{"summary":"A Gujarat couple from Dahod, Ramsinh (44) and Kanu Sangot (40), finally opted for family planning, with Kanu undergoing a tubectomy, only after having 17 children (16 daughters and one son) because villagers persuaded them after years of trying for another son."}

{"summary":"At Comic-Con, BBC America released an Orphan Black blooper reel after season four. The mistake the post teases: Tatiana Maslany, playing Cosima, tells someone on the phone that they need to talk to Cosima, which shows the confusion of playing multiple clone characters."}

{"summary":"Beyond the Big Mac index, Bloomberg compared currency values using lattes, pizza, Hooters wings and Nobu's black cod, finding the dollar looks overvalued in most. A latte shows it about 10% overvalued against the yen and 25% against the pound, while pizza suggests the euro is nearly 50% undervalued."}

{"summary":"No, you generally don't need to fast before a cholesterol test: studies show eating barely changes LDL, HDL, or total cholesterol results, though fasting may slightly improve triglyceride accuracy. U.S. guidelines still \"prefer\" fasting, but many European countries and experts say nonfasting tests are fine and make testing easier."}

{"summary":"The post's \"orphan cats\" were actually baby genets, orphaned in South Africa when kids threw rocks at their mother. The surprise was that a shelter dog named Candy, a poodle-cocker spaniel mix, adopted and nursed them, even producing milk without being pregnant; two were later released and one stayed."}

{"summary":"Michigan mom Dayna Mager was photographed by her husband asleep in baby Luella's crib because she goes to comfort her every time she cries. After a missionary described silent babies in a Ugandan orphanage who had learned that crying brings no response, she vowed never to let her baby cry alone."}

{"summary":"No, the person in the 1995 Mike Tyson fight video isn't a time traveler with a cameraphone; Snopes says the device was likely one of many handheld cameras widely available in 1995, like the Casio QV-10A. The article adds that hindsight bias leads people to misread old footage, such as a 1922 \"wireless phone\" that was really a radio."}

{"summary":"The phone is the Turing Phone Cadenza, a concept smartphone from California's Turing Robotic Industries running Swordfish OS with deep-learning AI. Claimed specs include two Snapdragon 830 chips, 12GB RAM, 1TB storage, a 60MP rear camera, 4 SIM slots and a graphene supercapacitor plus hydrogen fuel cell battery, with release expected next year."}

{"summary":"Syracuse University is the school whose students order the most late-night food, according to a GrubHub analysis of 350+ campuses: 1 in 4 of their orders come between 10 p.m. and 2 a.m. Overall, college students are 87% more likely than average diners to order late-night meals."}

{"summary":"The new M&M is M&M's Mega, a larger candy with three times the chocolate of regular M&M's. It arrives in stores in May 2014 in milk chocolate and peanut varieties, with small bags at $1.49 and medium bags at $3.29, following focus-group requests for bigger candies."}

{"summary": "A Lovehoney survey of 4,400 customers found the average sex session lasts 19 minutes, including about 10 minutes of foreplay. Just over half were satisfied, though about a fifth wanted longer; respondents may be more sexually liberated than average."}

{"summary":"The article lists 10 low-effort health tips for 2017: drink less juice, fix your posture, breathe properly, garden, stretch 10 minutes daily, try a sensory deprivation tank, take walks, let yourself sneeze, cut back on stressful Twitter news, and drink one glass of warm water daily."}

{"summary":"The biggest limitation of Nintendo's $60 NES Classic Edition is that it can't add games: it has no internet connection or external storage, and its cartridge slot is purely decorative, so you're stuck with the 30 built-in titles. Nintendo says it's a standalone nostalgia device aimed at casual older fans, not hardcore gamers."}

{"summary":"Pouring milk into a bottle of Coke makes the mixture turn clear within about an hour, with curdled chunks sinking to the bottom, because Coke's phosphoric acid reacts with and coagulates the milk. The article ties this to concerns that phosphoric acid in colas may reduce bone density, though more research is needed."}

{"summary":"The USDA has approved four Chinese poultry processors to export cooked chicken to the U.S., meaning your chicken nuggets could be processed in China without any origin labeling or on-site USDA oversight. For now the meat must come from U.S.-raised birds, but critics fear rules will change given China's food safety record."}

{"summary": "After someone burned student Ben Schofield's American flag in the Wasatch High School parking lot in Heber City, Utah, classmates put out the fire, and dozens of students rallied in patriotic colors with flags at a nearby Wal-Mart. Ben returned the next day flying a new flag from his truck, and police are investigating."}

{"summary":"Alison Pill told Conan O'Brien she accidentally tweeted a topless selfie last September because she didn't realize her new BlackBerry had a touch screen while replying to someone on Twitter. She called it dumb and hideously embarrassing, said she'd taken the photo while apart from her then-fiance, and deleted it quickly."}

{"summary":"America's most popular dog breed is the Labrador retriever, which extended its record run at No. 1 in the American Kennel Club rankings to 26 straight years. Rottweilers rose to No. 8, their highest ranking in nearly 20 years, while French bulldogs and several other breeds also climbed."}

{"summary":"An Argentine farmer, Jose, found a roughly two-ton fossil on his property in Carlos Spegazzini near Buenos Aires on Christmas Day. It was the shell of a glyptodon, a giant armored armadillo relative from the Pleistocene, at least 10,000 years old, as paleontologist Alejandro Kramarz confirmed."}

{"summary":"The prank was that Anthony, who graduated just a year earlier, showed up to his 17-year-old sister Anelle's graduation wearing a cap and gown. He sat in the family's prominent box seats, and Anelle, who was onstage as class secretary, struggled to hold in her laughter."}

{"summary":"A viral Twitter theory from @strnks says Friends should have ended with Phoebe, a meth-addicted outsider with a troubled past, sitting alone in Central Perk and imagining all 10 seasons about five real friends she watches through the window, projecting herself into their lives."}

{"summary":"You get arrested: Michel Bechard stripped fully naked at a White House security gate on Friday and was taken into police custody after he assaulted a uniformed Secret Service officer who tried to subdue him."}

{"summary":"The leaves are bay leaves, the common soup and stew herb. Cockroaches hate their smell, so placing dried, crushed bay leaves in corners and food areas like the kitchen (and garden) can repel them, though the article offers no evidence that it eliminates them permanently."}

{"summary":"Madden NFL 2016 predicts the Carolina Panthers will beat the Denver Broncos 24-20 in Super Bowl 50, with Cam Newton as MVP. The annual simulation, run once on All-Madden difficulty, has correctly picked the winner nine times in 12 years."}

{"summary":"The \"good thing\" Texas did: Republican primary voters rejected Mary Lou Bruner, a State Board of Education candidate who claimed Obama was a former gay prostitute and that Noah carried baby dinosaurs. She lost by a wide margin to Kevin M. Ellis, a chiropractor and school board president."}

{"summary":"The FBI arrested a man suspected of spraying a mixture of hand cleaner, water, and Tomcat mouse poison on salad bars, hot food bars, and produce at a Whole Foods in Ann Arbor, Michigan, and at stores in Flint including a Meijer. No illnesses were reported, his name and motive are unknown, and he may face felony food adulteration charges."}

{"summary":"The post is teasing the discovery of Tamu Massif, the world's largest volcano, hidden beneath the northwest Pacific on Shatsky Rise. It is about 400 miles wide but only 2.5 miles tall, extinct for roughly 144 million years, and nearly as large as Mars' Olympus Mons."}

{"summary":"To see the supermoon, look at the sky after sunset on Sunday, Aug. 10, 2014, when the full moon (at 2:10 p.m. EDT) coincides with its closest approach to Earth, making it the year's biggest, up to 14% closer and 30% brighter than other full moons. Check the U.S. Naval Observatory site for local times; the Perseid meteor shower may add shooting stars."}

{"summary":"Simpsons writer John Swartzwelder has joined Twitter, but instead of writing new jokes he only tweets dry one-liners pulled from his own detective novels, with links to buy them. The article calls this the best/worst approach: pure self-promotion that doubles as deadpan performance art."}

{"summary":"Scientists don't agree on one reason cats purr: it may signal happiness, but also anxiety, hunger, or appeasement, and its 25-150 Hz frequency may promote self-healing of muscle and bone. Some vets think it has little meaning, so the purr remains partly a mystery."}

{"summary":"The marriage that ended is Adrienne Maloof and Paul Nassif's: the former \"Real Housewives of Beverly Hills\" star and her husband announced in a joint statement that they have settled all divorce issues and litigation. They plan to co-parent their three children after filing in August 2012."}

{"summary":"The Fallout 4 world record, set by speedrunner BubblesDelFuego, is a little over an hour (the article gives no exact time), versus 100+ hours for most players. It relies on glitches like quick reload, item climbing, Power Armor clipping and cover slides to skip to the final quest, and he expects 45-55 minutes eventually."}

{"summary":"The favorite word is \"badass.\" The article compiles a dozen interview quotes from 2013-2014 in which Shailene Woodley uses it to describe her Divergent character Tris, co-star Theo James, author Veronica Roth, her stunt double, and even the idea of shaving her head."}

{"summary":"The article lists ten under-the-radar pop songs from March 2017, which the post teases: The Drums' \"Blood Under My Belt\", Offaiah's \"Run\", Computer Games' \"Every Single Night\", Nelly Furtado's \"Phoenix\", Amine's \"REDMERCEDES\", Maddie Ross, B.O.Y., Louis the Child feat. Ashe, Steps, and TYSM's \"Wraith\"."}

{"summary":"The post's six steps are all sleep habits that Siphiwe Baleka, a former trucker turned fitness trainer, says normalize the hormones regulating metabolism and hunger: use a sleep tracker, keep a fixed bedtime and wake time, turn off screens an hour before bed, keep electronics out of the bedroom, drink chamomile tea, and read a book."}

{"summary": "The cylinder on your charger cord is a ferrite bead, which filters out high-frequency electromagnetic noise. Because the cable can act like an antenna, broadcasting or picking up radio interference, the iron-oxide ferrite blocks those signals so they don't disrupt your WiFi, speakers, or other electronics."}

{"summary":"Tesla's \"Master Plan, Part Deux\" says it will expand beyond sedans and SUVs into a compact SUV and an electric pickup truck, plus a heavy-duty Semi truck and high-density urban transport (both slated for debuts around 2017). It also aims to overhaul its production methods to build more vehicles faster."}

{"summary": "Climate change is making polar bears turn to cannibalism: as Arctic ice disappears and seal hunting gets harder, desperate adult males are killing and eating younger bears. A National Geographic video captured a male chasing down and preying on a mother's cub."}

{"summary":"The cancer is melanoma: a preliminary JAMA Internal Medicine study of nearly 26,000 men found past Viagra users had about double the melanoma risk, and current users an 84 percent higher risk. Researchers say it's too early to change prescriptions but urge further study."}

{"summary":"The post teases a list of 23 products for misanthropes; it's a BuzzFeed shopping roundup of antisocial-themed items costing roughly $5 to $130, such as a conversation-deterring scarf, 'leave me alone' tees and hoodies, a bed tent, an ostrich pillow, loner-themed pins, prints and mugs, mostly from Amazon and Etsy."}

{"summary":"Walter White will be showing up everywhere because AMC is launching an Emmy campaign for Breaking Bad, with billboards across Los Angeles urging TV Academy voters to honor the final eight episodes of Season 5, after the show won Outstanding Drama Series last year."}

{"summary":"The three longest flights by distance are Air India's roughly 9,400-mile route (14.5 hours, now the longest), Emirates' 8,820-mile flight (just over 17 hours), and a Qantas 8,577-mile flight (16 hours). Rankings will soon change as Qantas' Perth-London and Singapore Air's Singapore-New York nonstops launch."}

{"summary":"The major problem is that Tim Cook and Elon Musk are completely incompatible CEOs: Cook is a cautious supply-chain manager while Musk is a visionary who answers to no one and runs Tesla for a larger mission. Since they couldn't coexist, Musk would have to leave after an Apple buyout, and he doesn't want to."}

{"summary":"The city is Houston, which demographers forecast will pass Chicago as the third-largest US city within eight to 10 years, reaching about 2.54-2.7 million people by 2025. Its growth comes from an energy-driven economy, strong job creation, low taxes and diversity, despite traffic and air quality problems."}

{"summary": "The Pokemon CEO confirmed Pokemon is coming to Nintendo's NX, saying the console aims to change what it means to be a home or handheld device, which supports rumours it's a hybrid. Reports of a portable console with detachable controllers remain unconfirmed speculation."}

{"summary":"Netflix announced that Season 2 of \"Orange Is The New Black\" premieres June 6, revealed during the credits of the \"House Of Cards\" Season 2 finale. Laura Prepon returns as Alex for at least four episodes and Lori Petty joins the cast."}

{"summary":"The step is Defence Minister Manohar Parrikar's proposal to create all-women combat battalions in the Army, Navy and Air Force, which would also sidestep resistance to women officers commanding men, along with admitting women through the NDA and Sainik schools. He said change must be gradual and noted that bureaucratic delay held up the file on inducting women."}

{"summary":"The characteristic is being a good storyteller: in studies with undergrads, women rated men described as great storytellers as more attractive long-term partners and higher status, possibly because storytelling signals the ability to gain resources and influence. Men were not swayed by women's storytelling skill."}

{"summary":"The overlooked issue is menopause at work: European guidelines urge employers to adapt workplaces, such as cooler temperatures, flexible schedules, stress reduction, bathroom access, and manager training, because poor conditions can worsen symptoms like hot flashes and insomnia and hurt performance, yet few employers address it."}

{"summary":"The Golden State Warriors are No. 1 in this week's NBA Power Rankings for the fourth straight week, on a nine-game win streak, with the Grizzlies right behind (an NBA-best 15 wins, two losses) and arguably deserving No. 1A; Rockets, Blazers and Spurs round out the all-West top five, and the 76ers are last."}

{"summary":"The thing the post is teasing is daily morning meditation. The article says meditation suits everyone, with no right or wrong way, and can improve focus, reduce stress and prevent health ailments; it promotes a simple one-minute technique from China shown in a video, plus a free morning meditation MP3."}

{"summary":"Robert Schwentke, who directed \"Red\" and the flop \"R.I.P.D.\", will direct \"Insurgent,\" the \"Divergent\" sequel, replacing Neil Burger, who didn't return because of the tight turnaround before the March 2015 release date."}

{"summary": "The \"trick\" is to stop measuring success by page views and instead measure impact, such as completion rate, shares per view, and asking readers if they loved a story. NPR's Brian Boyer is building Carebot, a Knight-funded tool, to do this, and early tests showed donation clicks rose tenfold after asking readers if they loved a story."}

{"summary":"Prince George wears shorts because of an aristocratic British tradition tied to social class, dating to the 16th century 'breeching' custom, when young boys moved from gowns to breeches/shorts, with trousers seen as men's wear. Etiquette expert William Hanson says the royals keep this up, viewing trousers on little boys as a 'suburban' practice."}

{"summary":"The item every man needs in his closet is a leather jacket, which suits nearly any outfit and has been a cool-guy staple for decades. The article advises choosing a style (lapel, moto, or bomber) and a budget, trying faux leather if unsure, and avoiding leather blazers."}

{"summary":"The post's \"In pictures\" teases a photo gallery: a selection of shortlisted images from the Sony World Photography Awards, drawn from over 220,000 entries, with the winner to be announced on 20 April. The photos include Mount Fuji during a marathon, a panda cub at a Chinese reserve, a child trainee bullfighter in Mexico, and portraits of people in India, Armenia and Cuba."}

{"summary": "The article says Bollywood actor and former supermodel Dino Morea has a lookalike in Scott Foley, who plays Jake in the American TV series Scandal. It claims the resemblance is striking and notes that others have pointed it out too, including in a tweet."}

{"summary":"The update is that Pokémon Go will add advertising through \"sponsored locations,\" where companies pay Niantic to be placed in the game as in-game spots that drive foot traffic to their stores. The satirical article jokes that users will be upset, but notes the model is highly effective."}
